app.title: neca — strongSwan IKEv2 client certificate manager
app.global.dry_run: --dry-run      print planned actions; do not write or call docker
app.global.yes: --yes, -y      skip Y/N confirmation (backend automation only; audited)
app.global.lang: --lang LANG    console language: zh-CN (default) or en-US
app.footer: Run neca without arguments for the interactive wizard; use --dry-run before production changes.
wizard.title: neca interactive wizard (0 to exit)
cmd.version.summary: show version, commit, build time and target platform
cmd.index.summary: index maintenance (index sync: fill index and metadata)
cmd.issue.summary: issue a certificate (optional bundles, p12 profile, zip)
cmd.revoke.summary: revoke a certificate and update the CRL
cmd.delete.summary: delete certificate, client bundle and metadata (requires --yes)
cmd.package.summary: rebuild platform bundles from an existing certificate (optional zip)
